name: Train
tips: `sl` exists because people type `sl` when they mean `ls`. The joke is the lesson: slow down and read what you typed before you press Enter.
Press Tab while you type a command: the shell completes the name for you, so typos like `sl` never happen.
Ctrl+C stops almost every program, because it sends the SIGINT signal. The `sl` train ignores that signal on purpose, so you have to wait for it to pass.
`sl -l` draws a little train, `sl -a` adds passengers calling for help, `sl -F` makes it fly. Read `man sl` to see them all.
personal: Choo choo! You typed `sl` and here I am.
All aboard! Next stop: your home folder.
I'm the oldest joke in the terminal, and I still run on time.
